# Current project facts

<!-- Generated by tools/docs-facts.ts from implementation and accepted rule fixtures. -->

## Rule catalog

The current catalog contains 103 rules across 12 language directories, with 50 distinct rule IDs. 83 rules reach precision and recall 1.00 on their own accepted fixtures. There are 728 labelled defects and 1167 labelled cleans. These are fixture measurements, not production accuracy.

- git: 2 rules
- go: 9 rules
- javascript: 1 rule
- json: 1 rule
- markdown: 13 rules
- moonbit: 20 rules
- python: 14 rules
- rust: 9 rules
- shell: 8 rules
- text: 1 rule
- typescript: 23 rules
- vibe: 2 rules

## Runtime

The package requires Node.js >=24. Its runtime dependencies are `@ast-grep/cli` and `yaml`.

## Default model

The default model is `jev-1.14.0`. Explicit CLI, configuration and environment overrides still apply.

## CI

The local CI command is `npm run ci`. Its complete package script is:

```sh
npm run skills:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run eval:replay && npm run eval:adoption && npm run docs:facts:check && npm run eval:documents && npm run docs:replay
```
